{{Quote|I am Dahal. You look innocent. Let me be your guide.|Dahal|<ref name="Invasion 4">[[Invasion 4|''Invasion'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Dahal''' was a low-scale criminal living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] he approached a group of young Jedi trainees, trying to "show them the vertical city", and stole [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] pouch. Later, he was confronted by Solo and [[Lowbacca]] and followed by [[Finn Galfridian]] during their search for the information regarding [[Yuuzhan Vong]] agents.

Dahal was later seen in the company of [[Spraug]] and [[Dray (Fallen Jedi)|Dray]]. Dray sensed that Finn Galfridian was returning to Nar Shaddaa, and had Dahal and Spraug buy him new clothes.
